scope: Development train+validation only; final-test data, metrics, and paths were not accessed.
method: Predeclared candidate comparison with 5-fold run-grouped stratified CV; 12 held-out runs/class/fold; equal run contribution before optional Normal class multiplier.
interpretation_note: Select candidate using development-only grouped CV and predeclared operational criteria. Candidate comparisons can still introduce selection optimism. No candidate result is a new final-test score; any materially selected change needs a new independent test.
